title: Tickets: ordered vs any order

feedback.message: That is only the green-then-red order. Add the red-then-green order too.

hints: Multiplication rule for (a): the second draw comes from [$n] − 1 tickets.
For (b), red-then-green is just as likely as green-then-red; add the two orders.
solution: (a) $\frac1{[$n]}\cdot\frac1{[$n]-1}$. (b) The two orders can't both happen, so add them: twice the answer to (a).
